changelog: **Each requisition is an applicant board (#1838):** `/company/requisitions/[id]` shows every application to the role in a column per stage (`APPLIED` … `WITHDRAWN`), each with the count the server computed — a `groupBy` over the same filter the rows come from, never the length of the loaded page. New `GET /api/company/requisitions/[id]/applications` (COMPANY: its own company's requisitions; ADMIN: its org's; anything else is a 404) filters in SQL by `stage`, `skill` (case-insensitive, inside the candidate's skills), `city`, `q` (name) and `answer.<questionId>=<value>` over `screeningAnswers`, and pages one column at a time with `?column=<STAGE>&page=N` (no counts on that call, so page 2 never re-reads the role). Cards show the applied date, the candidate's skills that the role asks for (`matchedSkills()`, Turkish-aware) and how many screening questions were answered; a card moves through a select (no drag), and several move or reject together through `/api/applications/bulk-stage` — a rejection needs a disposition code. The drawer reads `/api/company/candidates/[id]`, which now also admits a candidate who applied to one of the company's requisitions (still no e-mail, no phone; `mentorName`/`pipelineStatus` are `null` without a relation). The shortlist and interview-request controls moved onto the cards; `POST /api/interview-requests` accepts an application standing at `SHORTLISTED` as the shortlist. Pure rules in `src/lib/requisitionBoard.ts`.

en: A role's page is now an applicant board: one column per stage with live counts, filters by skill, city and name, moving one or several candidates at once, and a candidate preview without leaving the page.
tr: Bir pozisyonun sayfası artık bir aday panosu: her aşama için bir sütun ve güncel sayılar, yetkinliğe, şehre ve isme göre filtreler, bir veya birkaç adayı birlikte taşıma ve sayfadan çıkmadan aday önizlemesi.
de: Die Seite einer Stelle ist jetzt eine Bewerbungsübersicht: eine Spalte pro Phase mit aktuellen Zahlen, Filter nach Kompetenz, Stadt und Name, eine oder mehrere Bewerbungen auf einmal verschieben und eine Vorschau der Person, ohne die Seite zu verlassen.
